title: Cheap and already broken
text: Cheap and already broken. Ok I got this chair for a small home computer, not daily use. I needed something that does the job without costing a huge amount. The set-up was easy and the chair is comfortable enough for a short time of daily use, this chair is not ergonomic for daily full-time home office use. The chair has barely been used overall and it is already broken, I use the highest setting, but it just keeps on going down and you are sitting almost on the floor. You pull the chair back up and pfffff it takes you back down to the ground. I knew this wasn't the most expensive office chair, but I expected a couple of years with the minimal use. I would not buy this chair again, now I have to spend more money to get another one. I wish I had just spent a bit more in the first place.
